$comment: Companion to tsconfig.json, used by `npm run typecheck:tests`.
The main tsconfig excludes tests/e2e because those specs import
@playwright/test and run under Playwright's own tsconfig resolution, not
Next's. That left them with no type checking at all: `tsc --noEmit` skipped
them and eslint does not type check. This config includes them so the CI
typecheck step covers every TypeScript file in the repository.
Run after `npm run build`, because it extends the root config's include of
.next/types which Next generates during the build.
